apps.subtitle: Windows XP styled Nekochat client
apps.localizedDescription: An unofficial Nekochat client in the style of Windows XP: rooms, direct messages, voice calls, themes from .msstyles files, statuses and settings backups.

versions.localizedDescription: Games from Windows XP (Solitaire, Spider, FreeCell, Hearts, Spades, Reversi, Checkers, Backgammon, 3D Pinball), files in chats with Infinity Memory, and the Windows Update style Update window.
The Windows XP Control Panel, a catalog of cursors, sounds, icons and chat wallpapers, Windows Classic colour schemes, and replies, reactions, pins, mentions and link previews in chats.
Automatic updates, client badges next to statuses, the Nekochat Reloaded server by default and themes in backups.

privacy.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: Nekochat Reloaded uses the microphone for voice calls.
